question: What salvific role of Bhava warrants this obeisance from the devotee?
premises: Bhava is addressed as the recipient of obeisance.
Bhava destroys sorrow arising from worldly existence.
The devotee directs reverential salutation to that deity.
inference: Therefore obeisance is rightly offered to Bhava as the remover of existence-born suffering.
uncertainties: bhava may evoke both the deity Bhava and worldly existence within the compound.
plain_english: Obeisance be to you, Bhava, destroyer of the sorrow born of existence.
